sourceSemantics.depositor: deposit/depositAll pull PENDLE, optionally stake newly minted ePENDLE; conversion is irreversible and PENDLE goes to a proxy long lock. No PENDLE redemption function exists.
sourceSemantics.reward: stake/stakeAll/stakeFor pull stakingToken; withdraw/withdrawAll return caller staking tokens and also claim configured rewards with booster callback. emergencyWithdraw skips reward payout but retains accounting and whenNotPaused. getReward pays the specified account, not caller-selected alternative. Role-gated Claimfor/withdrawFor and donation/reward administration are excluded.
sourceSemantics.vault: Auto-compounder deposit pulls ePENDLE, mints nontransferable shares and stakes in reward pool; withdrawal burns shares and pays ePENDLE less configurable withdrawal fee. updateReward may call harvest, which swaps WETH to PENDLE through a configured Balancer pool with zero minimum, converts through configured smartConvertor and restakes. No caller opaque calldata is accepted; this does not override lifecycle exclusion.
sourceSemantics.lifecycle: Current live JS explicitly announces Equilibria wind-down; route and distributor naming corroborate. Stale docs, remaining deposit ABI, live historical UI modules and recent exits do not establish maintained active admission.

limitations: All functions excluded due to protocol wind-down. No catalog, frontend card or capability should be generated from this historical inventory.
Reviewed deployed implementation ABIs and separate proxy ABIs are retained; current runtime identity, pause state, configuration or successful execution is not attested.
App source contains V1/V2 sidechain migration logic; no bridge, zap, executor, role or legacy recovery capability admitted.
